units.source_text: 我凭倚在精致的栏杆上，心不在焉地俯视着地面。

en.t: I leaned against the delicate railing and absentmindedly looked down at the ground.

units.source_text: 在夕阳的映照下，地面恍如生了锈的古铜镜，金阁的影子垂直地投落在镜面上。

en.t: In the glow of the setting sun, the ground looked like a rusted old bronze mirror, and the shadow of the Golden Pavilion fell straight down onto its surface.

units.source_text: 水草和藻类的最下方，映现出傍晚的天空。

en.t: At the very bottom beneath the water plants and algae, the evening sky appeared reflected.

units.source_text: 这傍晚的天空，与我们头上的天空不同。

en.t: This evening sky was different from the sky above our heads.
